notes.title: Cosmic Call is basically Nuclear Throne as a rogue-lite boomer shooter
notes.notes:
CosmicDev recently put up a demo for Cosmic Call, a very scribbly-styled retro boomer shooter that sees you fight through small arena levels as you keep powering up.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/09/cosmic-call-is-basically-nuclear-throne-as-a-rogue-lite-boomer-shooter
